description.id: Bolu cokelat lembap berlapis krim vanila dan selai stroberi, dihias irisan jeruk manis. Ukuran 18 cm, cukup untuk 10–12 orang.
description.en: Moist chocolate sponge layered with vanilla cream and strawberry jam, topped with candied orange. 18 cm, serves 10–12.

description.id: Sponge cake ringan dengan whipped cream segar dan stroberi utuh. Manisnya pas, cocok untuk ulang tahun.
description.en: Feather-light sponge with fresh whipped cream and whole strawberries. Gently sweet — a birthday favourite.

description.id: Chiffon tinggi dan empuk dengan pandan asli dan santan. Wangi, ringan, dan tidak terlalu manis.
description.en: Tall, airy chiffon made with real pandan and coconut milk. Fragrant, light and not too sweet.

description.id: Difermentasi perlahan selama 24 jam. Kulitnya renyah, bagian dalamnya lembut dan sedikit asam.
description.en: Slow-fermented for 24 hours. A crackly crust with a soft, gently tangy crumb.

description.id: Gulungan roti lembut dengan kayu manis dan gula aren, disiram cream cheese frosting.
description.en: Soft swirls of cinnamon and palm sugar, finished with cream cheese frosting.

description.id: Roti tawar susu yang super lembut dan sobek-sobek. Enak dimakan langsung atau dipanggang.
description.en: Cloud-soft milk bread that pulls apart in strands. Lovely plain or toasted.
